drivingSustainability.headline: Driving Sustainability with Data
drivingSustainability.description: At SmartGrid, we leverage aerial and terrestrial geospatial tools to support environmental protection, conservation, and sustainable land use through precision monitoring.

items.title: NDVI & Habitat Analysis
items.description: Multispectral drone imaging for vegetation health and ecosystem vitality.

items.title: Watershed Mapping
items.description: River basin terrain, hydrology and erosion risk analysis for planning.

items.title: Thermal Imaging
items.description: Identifying pollution, urban heat zones, and water quality issues via aerial infrared.

items.title: Wetland Boundaries
items.description: Accurate delineation for riparian protection and EIA documentation.

techWeUse.headline: Technology We Use
techWeUse.description: Our team utilizes LiDAR drones, RTK GNSS units, total stations, bathymetry kits and advanced GIS software such as QGIS, Pix4D, and ArcGIS Pro. These tools help us provide detailed, spatially accurate insights to support your environmental needs.

items.title: Reservoir Monitoring
items.description: Track sediment levels and plan dredging strategies for long-term sustainability.

items.title: Vegetation Loss Tracking
items.description: Compare seasonal aerial surveys to detect changes and inform conservation

items.title: Flood Risk Zones
items.description: Model runoff, catchments, and build flood resilience maps for local authorities.

whyPartnerWithUs.headline: Why Partner With Us?
whyPartnerWithUs.description: We deliver high-quality geospatial and survey intelligence for sustainable outcomes. Our responsive team ensures timely reporting, customizable services, and GIS outputs that are compatible with your workflow.

whatWeOffer.headline: What We Offer
whatWeOffer.description: At SmartGrid Surveying & Engineering Ltd, we combine drone technology, remote sensing, and GIS expertise to provide actionable insights for environmental decision-making. Our services are trusted by environmental consultants, conservation NGOs, developers, and regulatory bodies across Kenya and the region.
